exclusions.what: Sheet '4C' (Fig.4C): 8 columns PBS (-), PBS+CD210, AS1 WT, AS1+CD210, mIL10.4, mIL10.4+CD210, mIL10.14, mIL10.14+CD210; one value per mouse row
exclusions.reason: Single measured timepoint (T = 19 h per caption 'The percentage of wound remaining was calculated at T = 19 h'); not measured repeatedly over time (protocol 1.0.0 inclusion rule 1). The definitional baseline (1.1.0 section 3) only supplies the hour-0 normalizer and does not convert a single-timepoint endpoint into a longitudinal trajectory.

exclusions.what: Sheet '5D' (Fig.5D): 3 columns PBS (-), AS1 WT, hIL10.3; one value per mouse row
exclusions.reason: Single measured timepoint (T = 19 h per caption); not measured repeatedly over time (protocol 1.0.0 inclusion rule 1); same definitional-baseline limit as sheet 4C.

Not in vivo corneal fluorescein wound-area time series (bacterial phosphatase/ELISA/CFU ratios, T-cell proliferation/cytokines, colonization CFUs, conjunctival/corneal flow cytometry, keratitis scores, P. aeruginosa burden, in vitro human cell scratch/PBMC assays) (protocol 1.0.0 inclusion rule 4).

notes: Fig.4B is the only longitudinal in vivo corneal wound-area panel. Values are 'percentage of wound remaining' defined relative to each mouse's own T0 defect area (Fig.4B caption; Methods 'mIL-10 effect on in-vivo corneal wounds'). Under extraction-protocol-1.1.0 section 3 a definitional hour-0 of 100% remaining is added per series (source_cells 'definition:...', baseline_observed true); the measured hours 10, 13, 16 and 19 are taken from sheet '4B' column A (one mouse per data column, PBS (-) cols B-N & P, AS1 WT cols Q-X & Z-AE, mIL10.4 cols AF-AO & AQ-AT, mIL10.14 cols AU-AX, AZ & BB-BI; empty separator columns O, Y, AP, AY, BA). Methods state photographs were taken at T=0, 10 h and every 3 h until the first wounds showed full closure at 22 h; the deposited sheet contains the 10/13/16/19 h rows only (no 22 h row, no deposited T0 row). Authors' outcome-dependent inclusion threshold (QUANTIFICATION AND STATISTICAL ANALYSIS): 'Only wounds that healed at least 15% after 19 h were included in the analysis.' Recorded as stated; rows were NOT filtered or modified by the extractor -- every deposited mouse column is kept. Whether the deposited rows were themselves pre-filtered by the authors is unknown. Roles: PBS (-) = control (vehicle inoculation); AS1 WT, mIL10.4, mIL10.14 = treated (bacterial colonization, including wild-type bacteria). Basement membrane recorded intact because Methods state the abrasion was made 'without disrupting the basement membrane'. The raw sheet header for the control group is 'PBS (-)' with a non-breaking space (U+00A0); it is normalized to 'PBS (-)' for the group name. Caption says wounding one week after the final inoculation; Methods say two weeks (discrepancy recorded, not resolved). Source cells use the verbatim sheet name '4B' followed by '!'.
